name: billsplit
description: Split group expenses with friends. A Tricount-style app on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

scripts.deploy: nuxt generate web && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy && pnpm run deploy:staging
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && pnpm run db:seed:staging && env -u WRANGLER_CI_OVERRIDE_NAME -u WRANGLER_CI_MATCH_TAG wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:staging:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env staging && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --env staging --file seed/staging.sql
scripts.db:seed:staging: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --file seed/staging.sql
